ruleset.name: tesseraql-unused
ruleset.description: Dead code javac cannot see: -Xlint:all has no unused-declaration lints, so an unread private field, an uncalled private method or a parameter nothing reads sails through the failOnWarning gate and surfaces only in the IDE's JDT panel. These four rules close that gap; checkAll extends the parameter rule to non-private methods, where extraction leftovers accumulate (a router-installer signature kept a port nothing read six times over). A parameter kept deliberately - a uniform dispatch signature, an SPI shape - says so with @SuppressWarnings("PMD.UnusedFormalParameter") at the declaration.
